Data completeness: full months, real administrative boundary — 9508 recorded incidents total across 3 months (2026-04–2026-06), queried against Enfield's actual ONS 2021 polygon outline (the same shape shown on the map above), not an approximate circle. This is the complete monthly response from the UK Police API for each month in that window. Day score: 2.6196 weighted incidents/1,000 people, averaged over the last 3 months (104% of the 32-borough average). Night score: 11.2327 weighted incidents/1,000 people, same window (92% of the 32-borough average). Both are normalised by plain 2021 resident population (330,000) — no separate workday/footfall figure exists for Enfield in the ONS's 2011 workday-population release (the most recent one published), so no correction is applied here (ratio 1.0) rather than guessing one. This means Enfield's score may be slightly overstated relative to boroughs where a real commuter/footfall correction could be applied — see methodology. Rated against the average of the 32 boroughs currently on the automated pipeline.
